name: interrelated-root
description: Root tooling package. Owns the test runner for shared/ (which deliberately has no package.json of its own) and nothing else. Application packages (realtime/, web/, widget/) each own their dependencies.

scripts.depcruise: depcruise realtime/src realtime/scripts shared providers widget/src eval loadtest scripts --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs && depcruise web/src --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --ts-config tsconfig.depcruise-web.json
